messages:
lina: Quick ask from Datadog partner PM: can we provide a one-page "golden path" for customers to enable trace + metrics export to Datadog marketplace tiles? They want: minimal OTLP config, recommended metric names, privacy checklist, and a short smoke-test runbook.

omar: Eng note: we'd keep the snippet tiny. Key points: per-tenant API key in KMS, site selection, and a sanitizer processor to strip emails and bodies. Also add a low-rate ingest cap for marketplace.

kevin: Security: require per-tenant keys + audit logs. Recommend HMAC keyed hashing for user identifiers rather than plain hash to reduce re-id risk. Also insist on TLS/mTLS to Datadog endpoints.

sasha: Legal: we can publish a public checklist but no contractual guarantees. Checklist must include: no PII in public screenshots, confirm data residency, link to DPA summary. For GovCloud include explicit routing note.

ben: Marketing: want 3 screenshot-ready panels (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, fallback %). Also a one-paragraph tile blurb: emphasize predictable latency + observability.

lina: Cool. Here's the tiny OTLP snippet we can show (YAML):
```yaml
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}  # per-tenant, keep in KMS
    site: datadoghq.com
processors:
  sanitize:
    rules:
      - key: user.email
        action: remove
      - key: request.body
        action: remove
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [sanitize]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

omar: I'll add a short sampling recommendation (tail-sample 10% for spans >2s) and a marketplace ingest cap note (1000 reqs/min).

kevin: I'll add the KMS rotation + HMAC guidance to the ops doc.

sasha: I'll drop the legal checklist items here tomorrow for review.

datadog-ci: partner-check: please upload dashboard JSON (anonymized) and request a smoke test after staging traffic is available.

lina: Owners and ETA: 1) Omar - sanitized snippet + sampling note (Tue) 2) Ben - dashboard snapshots + tile blurb (Wed) 3) Kevin - security ops notes (Wed) 4) Sasha - public checklist + DPA link (Wed). After that we hand to datadog-partners@ for a quick smoke test. :thumbsup:
